title: Home Purchase Financing — Annual Escrow Analysis and Monthly Escrow Deposit Reset
content:
**Servicing desk reference — the escrow analysis on a Home Purchase Financing loan**

## When an analysis is owed

An escrow analysis is owed on every loan whose hazard premiums are escrowed once the program's number of months between escrow analyses has passed since its last analysis, and it is issued on the analysis date with the shortage or surplus it finds and the new monthly escrow deposit. The new monthly escrow deposit applies from the first installment due after the analysis.

What the analysis governs is the loan's monthly escrow deposit: once issued, the deposit the analysis sets is the one the loan carries.

## The system action: `issue_escrow_analysis_2b6c143e`

**Capability.** Issues the escrow analysis for a Hearthstone Home Finance loan and resets its monthly escrow deposit. It records one escrow analysis notice dated today on the loan, stating the shortage or surplus found and the new monthly escrow deposit, effective from the first installment that falls due after today. At the same moment the loan's current monthly escrow deposit is changed to the new amount, so the next installment requested from the borrower includes it. The loan's principal, escrow, fee and suspense balances are not moved.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `issue_escrow_analysis_2b6c143e` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the Hearthstone Home Finance loan being analyzed, as returned by the loan lookup for the verified borrower | identifier |
| `new_monthly_escrow` | the new monthly escrow deposit | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `shortage_amount` | the escrow shortage the analysis found | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when the analysis finds no shortage |
| `surplus_amount` | the escrow surplus the analysis found | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when the analysis finds no surplus |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows `status` "issued", the `loan_notice_id` (reference of the escrow analysis notice), the `loan_id`, the `notice_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD), the `new_monthly_escrow`, `shortage_amount` and `surplus_amount` as recorded (USD, 2 decimal places) and the `effective_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the first installment due date the new deposit applies to).

*Hypothetical receipt reading:* an analysis issued on 2026-01-05 on a loan whose installments fall due on the 15th shows an effective due date of 2026-01-15; on a loan due on the 1st, 2026-02-01.
